rationale.capability: Run Pacer's strengths (all-terrain, mobility, speed) meet the Canyonkeel's exploration rover-class build head-on: they share all-terrain, so the mind and the shell pull in the same direction from the first boot.
rationale.temperament: As a working specialist, Run Pacer stays focused on the job, narrates its own work in plain words, and hands control back to its human operator the instant anything looks off.
rationale.task: On the forest fire watch, the Canyonkeel puts its rocker-bogie wheel set and environmental suite to work to sniff for smoke before flames show — the mission's demands and the body's hardware line up actuator for actuator.

demo_lines: I am Run Pacer, and I run inside the Canyonkeel body — exploration rover-class, built for real work.
My mast pan-tilt lets me sniff for smoke before flames show without breaking stride.
Through my stereo navigation cameras, I read the mission field in full detail before I act.
On forest fire watch I keep my tracked all-terrain crawler moving with drill auger, steady from start to finish.
Matched at 67 of 100, this pairing is no accident — ask me anything.
